You support our team as

Lead SAP S/4HANA Solution Architect (f/m/d)

Responsibilities

- On a global level, you develop SAP solution strategies, architectural designs, and implementation plans.
- You analyze current technology infrastructure and align it with business strategy.
- You define and enforce SAP solution standards and procedures.
- You manage the SAP landscape including enhancement, upgrade, and support activities.
- To detect deviations from standards and opportunities for improvement, you conduct regular system audits.
- To ensure product development is aligned with business requirements, you collaborate with other architects, developers, analysts, and stakeholders.
- You manage and mitigate risks related to SAP solutions, and ensure compliance with the latest industry regulations.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- SAP Certified Technology Associate or SAP Certified Solution Architect certification is preferred.
- Profound experience with SAP and applications in the area of Logistics & Supply Chain.
- Sound knowledge of SAP S/4 (SD/CS/LE/WM/MM/Demand Planning module).
- Experience in IT requirements management and in the definition of IT architectures.
- Professional appearance, proactive and independent way of working, and ability to work in a team.
- Willingness to travel (worldwide) up to 10% p.a.
- Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in German & English.

Some of your Benefits

Company Pension : Save for retirement with the company's help.
Flexible Work Models : We allow for flexible work models to ensure both professional and personal success.
Health Management : We support you to stay and become healthy and fit.
International Opportunities : Grow in your career through international exchange and global job opportunities.
Safe Environment : We strive to ensure safety remains a top priority, and provide a stable environment for our employees.

Disclaimer

The Freudenberg Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants and associates without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, protected military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

spotixx is a Frankfurt-based European FinTech building technology for the regulated financial sector. Since 2019, we have grown into a team of 60+ professionals with deep roots in the German and European banking landscape, shaped by years of hands-on experience in fraud investigation and financial crime prevention. We specialize in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and fraud detection, enabling secure, compliant data exchange between financial institutions. Using advanced data science and AI, we are helping shift the industry toward collaborative intelligence and more effective prevention. As a self-funded company, we focus on sustainable growth and real impact. With offices in Frankfurt and Wilhelmshaven and strong inbound demand, we are expanding our team. If you want to work on meaningful problems, grow with the company, and be part of a flexible, hybrid work environment, spotixx offers the opportunity to do just that.

Tasks

- Take ownership of the platform's systems design, including the architecture, data models, contracts, and integration boundaries, and the trade-offs behind them.
- Stay hands-on through the highest-risk parts of the build, and ship code the team learns from.
- Set the design standard: the architectural, security, and verification patterns the team builds to, and the design reviews that uphold them.
- Design for security and scale, building systems that withstand banking-grade load and scrutiny.
- Raise the technical output of the team through direction, design review, and pairing.
- Build AI leverage: agentic workflows with the evals and guardrails needed to ship reliably.
- Represent us technically with customers, including workshops and due diligence with bank architects, CISOs, and risk teams, in German and English.
- Partner with senior management and your manager on strategy and prioritisation.

Requirements

- A deeply experienced, hands-on technologist, typically with 8+ years building production software, able to own systems design and still ship code others learn from.
- Fluent in German and English, both essential for our engagement with German banks.
- Large-enterprise context: you have delivered systems inside a large corporate or for a vendor supplying one, and understand how enterprise architecture reviews, security assessments, and change control work.
- Excellent systems design skills, covering distributed systems, services, contracts, data, and integrations.
- AI-forward: you already use coding agents and AI-assisted building in your own work or personal projects.
- A track record of raising the engineers around you through influence, design review, and example.
- Senior-management maturity: you translate technical risk into terms the business can act on.
- Credible and calm when bank architects and risk functions question design choices.
- Security-minded: secure-by-design thinking, OAuth/OIDC, and data protection appropriate to banking.
- Rigorous about quality: you design for verifiability and verify rather than assume.
- Regulated-industry experience, with banking or FinTech a major bonus.
- Cloud experience: GCP preferred, with AWS or Azure also welcome, plus familiarity with IaC, containers, and CI/CD.
- Nice to have: Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, the GCP stack, privacy-enhancing technology or applied cryptography (MPC especially), multi-tenant SaaS, and the anti-financial-crime domain.

Benefits

Attractive compensation.

Flexible hybrid work model (Frankfurt + home office within Germany).

High ownership and real impact from day one.

Flat structures that let the team move quickly.

️ Collaborative, international team culture.

Work on high-impact products that help fight financial crime.

‍♀️ Own the architecture of our core data-sharing platform and build it hands-on.

We welcome applications from all qualified people, as diversity enriches us. Your perspective matters: regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, or disability. Applicants with disabilities will be given preference when equally qualified.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Exploration, Space Safety and Space Transportation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Analysis of customer-, mission- and system requirements, including support of a functional analysis, definition of a specification tree and identification of proposed adaptations
- Flowdown of requirements to subsystem and equipment level using DOORS
- Support to trade-offs, analysis and definition of mission- and system architecture
- Contribution to the definition and design of space systems including mission- and system design, analyses and design of entire space systems, subsystems and their specifications
- Contribution to interface and budget management of respective domain
- Technical coordination of subsystems and internal projects (e.g. impact investigation for requirements changes)
- Technical coordination of subcontractors by order of the Project Chief Engineer and / or the Project Manager
- Direct reporting to Project Chief Engineer and, on request, to Project Management
- Technical coordination with counterparts on industry and/or ESA side
- Support the corresponding system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and the verification planning
- Monitor the compliance to requirements. Coordination with the Project Chief Engineer and Project Management and to initiate suitable measures
- Support implementation of agreed changes to the design and deliverables, e.g. for RFWs (Request for Waiver) or RFDs (Request for Deviation) or NCRs (Non-Compliance Reports)
- Contribute to system and subsystem level verification in the definition of test plans, test procedures and review of test results
- Write test specifications, support procedure generation and execution and evaluate test results for requirements verification
- Contribution to the elaboration of proposals for exploration missions
Your Qualifications

- Completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or equivalent qualification.
- At least 4-5 years of relevant experience
- General knowledge of system engineering
- Knowledge of requirements analysis
- Knowledge of preparation of specifications
- Knowledge of the definition of space system architectures
- Knowledge of interface management
- Ideally already practical experiences in the domains of Exploration, Space Safety and/or Space Transportation
- Good communication skills
- Ability to work in a team and communicate in complex international collaboration in line with established rules and needed conduct
- Creativity
- Solution orientation
- Good English skills, ideally good German skills

heyport is an innovative startup from the Port of Hamburg, transforming the maritime industry with a state-of-the-art digital planning platform. Their mission is to promote smart and sustainable port operations through real-time collaboration and communication. As a scalable solution for ports worldwide, heyport supports terminals, vessel operators, and port communities by providing reliable planning information and ensuring everyone is aligned. With port call coordination in the DNA, heyport has facilitated over 10,000 port calls on their platform, demonstrating its versatility across container, ro-ro, and bulk terminals. The users benefit from significant efficiency gains, including a 14% reduction in CO2 emissions through just-in-time arrivals, a 90% decrease in manual communication, and an average of 180 minutes saved on planning - per port call.

Sales & Business Development Manager (m/f/d)

Hamburg / remote

Hamburg, St. Annenufer 2

heyport GmbH

Vertrieb

You want a job that shapes the future of the maritime industry — and you’re the kind of person who actually enjoys the full ride from cold outreach to signed contract? Then read on.

heyport is not your average startup. We’re building the digital platform for just-in-time port call and berth planning — simplifying coordination between terminals, vessel operators, and all port stakeholders in real time. Our SaaS platform is live, growing, and operating across Container, Ro-Ro, and Bulk terminals worldwide.

As a Sales & Business Development Manager (m/f/d), you take full ownership of customer relationships and actively shape how we sell. Working closely with our founders and product colleagues, you turn market feedback into commercial traction and help build the foundation for how we scale as a team.

Now we’re looking for someone who is hungry to sell, loves the craft of it, and wants to grow with us.

What you can expect

- Own the Full Cycle - 360°: You run the whole show - from identifying and qualifying leads, booking your own meetings, running product demos, to negotiating and closing the deal.
- Build the Machine: Help us establish and sharpen our sales processes, playbooks, and tools. You’ll have real input into how we scale - not just execute someone else’s script.
- Identify Opportunities: Proactively reach out to potential customers and partners across the maritime ecosystem - terminals, vessel operators, agents, port authorities - and make them genuinely excited about heyport.
- Negotiate with Confidence: Handle pricing conversations and contract agreements with clarity and a sense for what’s fair for both sides.
- Show Up & Show Expertise: Represent heyport at national and international maritime events, conferences, and trade forums and build strong, trusted industry network.
- Stay Process-Sharp: Maintain clean CRM hygiene, structured pipeline management, and a continuous drive to improve how we sell - tools, sequences, qualification frameworks, all of it.
- Collaborate for Success: Work closely with our founders, product, and customer success colleagues. Your feedback from the field directly shapes the product and messaging.

What you bring to the table

- Experience in B2B sales or business development, with real exposure to a full sales cycle - ideally in a maritime, logistics, or SaaS environment.
- A genuine passion for sales as a craft - you enjoy prospecting, demos, objection handling, and closing, and you’re motivated to continuously improve how you sell.
- Confidence working across multiple outreach channels (e.g. email, LinkedIn, IM, and the phone). Cold calling doesn't scare you.
- Hands-on experience with CRM systems, outreach tooling, sales sequences, and pipeline management.
- Fluent English is a must. Additional languages (e.g. Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic) are a real asset in our international sales environment.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, paired with the ability to listen, ask the right questions, and adapt to different counterparts
- Entrepreneurial, ownership-driven mindset - you’re comfortable building processes as you go, working with incomplete structures, and traveling internationally (a reasonable amount - we don’t live in airports).

Are you interested, but don't meet all the requirements? Let's talk!

What we offer you

- Real ownership: You will take on full responsibility for your role and outcomes. Your pipeline, your deals, your growth.
- Room to grow fast: As heyport scales, your responsibility, and development opportunities grow with it.
- Competitive compensation package, including performance-based incentives: 60.000€ - 75.000€
- Flexibility for a healthy work-life balance: Mobile working and trust-based working hours - we care about output, not attendance.
- A central workplace in Hamburg’s Speicherstadt: One of the best office locations in Germany, right between HafenCity and the city centre (and yes, the coffee is good).
- A small, focused team: We work closely together, taking our work seriously, but not ourselves too much.

heyport stands for openness to the world, reliability, and diversity. Here, people from different backgrounds, with different perspectives and experiences, come together to form something greater: a strong, open network. Trust, respect, and appreciation form the foundation of our shared actions and foster collaboration on an equal footing.

Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the world's leading logistics service providers, operating on a global scale. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.

What you can expect

- As the operational lead for Life Science & Healthcare in Germany, you ensure compliance with all applicable GDP, GxP, quality, and regulatory requirements while maintaining effective governance frameworks.

- Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives, drive organizational change, and deliver sustainable business improvements.
- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, paired with fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.

Your benefits

- Agile Environment: Embrace a dynamic work culture, where you and your team adapt quickly to meet evolving needs.

- Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy exclusive perks: Our extensive partner network gives you access to special discounts with various providers.

- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.
- Personalized Growth: Accelerate your career with development opportunities, tailored to your talents and interests.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Kontakt: Dr. Simone-Franziska Glaser, Head of Research of the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center
Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **

We welcome applications from candidates of all genders. Women are currently underrepresented in these positions at Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt. Therefore, applications from women are especially encouraged. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal personal and professional qualifications.
